name: Blast 10
summary:
Blast 10 is an explosive puzzle game that's easy to learn, hard to master, and dangerously addictive. Connect numbered blocks to add them together; hit 10 and watch them explode, clearing nearby blocks and setting off satisfying chain reactions. But watch out—go over 10 and you'll create stubborn rocks that can stand in your way.

Three modes are included: Puzzle sets handcrafted challenges to solve, Survivor asks you to keep the board alive and rack up points for as long as you can, and Dig sends you blasting deeper through layers of blocks.
